purpose: Document first-party Seremban registry context and bounded anonymous cadastral geometry access review.
assessment: Official Seremban land-office procedures and JUPEM state survey context were found. A Negeri Sembilan government ArcGIS Lot Kadaster layer returned three safe polygon features anonymously, with native UPI identities. Runtime readiness remains held pending serial review.
registryAssessment: Local registry/procedure custody is evidenced by the official Pejabat Daerah dan Tanah Seremban pages; JUPEM is the survey/mapping source named by the cadastral layer. This is institutional/source evidence, not admission of an adapter or owner/title access.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Pejabat Daerah & Tanah Seremban portal lists land-tax, submission-status, forms, and land-title guidance services.
Official FAQ states land-ownership status is checked at the Registration Unit and cadastral plans can be purchased at JUPEM Negeri Sembilan or the Seremban land office technical counter.
Official JUPEM material describes cadastral surveying and electronic web mapping, and identifies the Negeri Sembilan office in Seremban.
Government ArcGIS Feature Layer Lot Kadaster: polygon geometry, EPSG:102062, copyright/source JUPEM 2020, native fields FID/MUKIM/PA/LOT/UPI/KELUASAN, GeoJSON supported.

searchQueries.query: Seremban Malaysia official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS JUPEM Negeri Sembilan
searchQueries.result: First-party local land-office, JUPEM, and public ArcGIS cadastral sources found; geometry verified with a bounded query.

searchQueries.result: Official Malay-language land-office procedure evidence and the Negeri Sembilan Lot Kadaster REST layer found; three safe polygons returned.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not used to shift coordinates or infer absence; the WUP point remains [2.70605282873579,101.958045373885].

sourceFieldMapping.UPI: native stable parcel identity; retained as properties.id

requestEvidence.result: Layer schema and EPSG:102062 polygon metadata returned.
Unbounded schema/attribute response returned; used only to establish native fields and safe identities, not retained raw.
Three polygon features returned in GeoJSON after server reprojection to EPSG:4326; reduced sample retained with UPI-only properties.
No verification bypass used; HTTP endpoint was used for the same public service and recorded above.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official local land-office pages, JUPEM material, current ArcGIS layer metadata, and bounded anonymous requests.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A public Negeri Sembilan cadastral polygon layer and three-feature sample are verified; citywide completeness and current freshness are not established.

remainingUncertainty: The sample is not spatially centered on the immutable WUP point and is not evidence of citywide completeness; serial review should test representative Seremban extents and adapter-safe request limits.
